title: PhD Position in Decision Neuroscience
institution: Erasmus University Rotterdam, Erasmus Research Institute of Management (ERIM)
about: PhD position in decision neuroscience within ERIM's full-time PhD in Management programme at Erasmus University Rotterdam. Published 2 November 2026; applicants receive decisions by mid-March.
requirements: Strong research orientation, evidenced for example by a master thesis or research article

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Strong research orientation, evidenced for example by a master thesis or research article" → "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
"master thesis or research article" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
